_comment: Harness-level enforcement of the research contract. Per owner directive 2026-07-24:
'OUR RESEARCH IS INVALID IF IT IS NOT COMPLIANT WITH OUR GOVERNANCE AND VERIFICATION
WHY HOOKS AND NOT PROSE: the 2026-07-24 research run skipped Co-1, citation mining, clause
citation and combinatorial pairing while the rules for all four sat documented in skills/,
governance/ and CLAUDE.md. The rules did not fail; PROSE failed — an agent must choose to
load it, and attention degrades as context fills. Hooks run at the HARNESS level: they fire
on every session regardless of what any agent has read or remembers.
SessionStart re-injects the contract at the top of every session (before context fills).
Stop runs the mechanical definition-of-done gate so a session cannot quietly end
non-compliant. Neither blocks work; both make non-compliance impossible to not-see.

hooks.command: printf '%s\n' '================ GUIDEBOOK RESEARCH CONTRACT (harness-injected) ================' 'RESEARCH IS INVALID IF NOT COMPLIANT WITH OUR GOVERNANCE, VERIFICATION TOOLS,' 'RULES AND ETHOS. Compliance is mechanical, not remembered.' '' 'BEFORE admitting evidence:' '  R1  Co-1/Co-2 LIVED EXPERIENCE pass FIRST - no exceptions (co-primary w/ T1, CRPD 4.3)' '  R10 Re-retrieve every locator. DOI -> Crossref/PubMed -> publisher -> repository.' '      A publisher block is NOT a terminal answer. No re-retrieval = no admission.' '  R9  Pre-check the DOI. If it exists, cross-file the existing ref_id - never duplicate.' '  R5  Non-English peer-reviewed work is ACADEMIC, not grey. Non-indexation in' '      PubMed/Scopus is an INDEXING fact, not an evidence-quality fact.' '' 'WHILE searching:' '  R4  Cross slug x population / access-need / ICF / axis. Cells are (item x population).' '  R2  Mine admitted T1-T3 anchors backward AND forward (depth 2-3). Not optional depth.' '  R8  Log EVERY query verbatim before screening. KEEP EMPTIES - a zero-yield search is a' '      COMPLETED unit of work. Never delete or backfill them.' '  R7  Capture FAILURE / HARM / INADEQUACY as first-class evidence, not a by-product.' '' 'WHEN filing:' '  R3  Quantified code/standard values need clause/section/page, else [UNVERIFIED-QUANT].' '  R6  Findings go in findings_note. deferred_reason means DELIBERATELY NOT SEARCHED.' '  R7  Off-slug or unverified material -> search_candidates (REHOME/MISC/PENDING), not prose.' '  R11 No back-translation. Every alias carries its in-language source, else [UNVERIFIED-TERMS].' '  R12 Case studies -> case_studies. Economics -> economics_entries. Code values ->' '      jurisdictional_values. Never leave them in prose notes.' '' 'ALWAYS: migrations-only (emit_data_migration -> migrate_db). Never hand-edit the DB.' 'Never author best_practice_synthesis below the Opus floor. Never move an adjudicated figure.' 'Gate before you claim done:  python3 scripts/audit/research_batch_dod.py --session <id>' '==============================================================================='
if [ -f scripts/audit/research_batch_dod.py ] && [ -f data/guidebook.db ]; then python3 scripts/audit/research_batch_dod.py --all 2>/dev/null | tail -n 20 || true; fi
